title: Optimization of probiotic beverage made from Sohiong fruit using response surface methodology and artificial neural network–genetic algorithm hybrid model
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00940E, Paper
Open Access

Roshiya Nongmaithem, Raju Sasikumar, Irengbam Barun Mangang, Selva Kumar T, Kambhampati Vivek, Amit K. Jaiswal
In this study, a probiotic beverage from Sohiong (Prunus nepalensis), an underutilized wild edible fruit rich in phenolics and anthocyanins, was optimized using both RSM and ANN–GA hybrid model.
